subject.title: fix(config): improve validation error messages with line numbers, bracket paths, and received values

question: Should this PR become the canonical implementation, and what exact confidentiality contract should govern printing effective received values in config-validation errors?
rationale: The correct diagnostic value comes from effective resolved configuration, but exposing that value broadens the CLI's secret-redaction boundary; the repository also has a viable overlapping bracket-only PR, so automation cannot choose the permanent behavior or canonical branch safely.

options.title: Adopt after bounded repair
options.body: Use this PR as canonical after rebasing, separating source-location lookup from effective-value lookup, and enforcing an approved scalar-only deny-by-default redaction contract with focused tests.

options.title: Land bracket-only first
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/104935 for bracket formatting and handle line locations and received values in a narrower follow-up after the confidentiality contract is designed.

options.title: Omit received values
options.body: Keep line numbers and bracket paths but remove received-value output if maintainers do not want resolved configuration values entering terminal diagnostics.

recommendation.title: Adopt after bounded repair
recommendation.body: Use this PR as canonical after rebasing, separating source-location lookup from effective-value lookup, and enforcing an approved scalar-only deny-by-default redaction contract with focused tests.
